channel.title: POLARIS · India's Polar Knowledge & Mission Updates
channel.description: Official scientific dispatches from Indian Antarctic, Arctic, and Southern Ocean expeditions, open cryosphere datasets, and peer-reviewed polar publications under MoES / NCPOR.

item.title: 44th Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica (44th IAE) Resupply and Deployment
item.description: Flagship summer voyage deploying 72 scientists aboard MV Vasiliy Golovnin to Maitri and Bharati stations, conducting firn coring, aerosol optical depth profiling, and atmospheric black carbon surveys.

item.title: New Open Dataset: Maitri Atmospheric Black Carbon & Surface Meteorology
item.description: Continuous hourly time-series (CSV / NetCDF) of equivalent black carbon (EBC) mass concentration, multi-wavelength absorption coefficients, and surface micro-meteorology from Maitri Station.

item.title: Southern Ocean CTD Meridional Hydrographic Transect Released
item.description: Full-depth (0–4,500m) Sea-Bird CTD casts across the 57°30′E meridian transect recording potential temperature, practical salinity, and dissolved oxygen.

item.title: Indian Arctic Winter Campaign at Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard
item.description: Year-round atmospheric observation of Arctic amplification, aerosol-cloud interactions, and Kongsfjorden fjord dynamics from Himadri station.

item.title: Publication: Decadal Variations in Antarctic Firn Density and Surface Mass Balance
item.description: Peer-reviewed study analyzing firn core records from Princess Elizabeth Land, documenting accelerated coastal accumulation and Southern Annular Mode teleconnections.

item.title: Himalayan Chhota Shigri Glacier Mass Balance Time-Series Updated
item.description: Glaciological specific mass balance, equilibrium line altitude (ELA), and accumulation area ratio (AAR) observations in the Chandra Basin.

item.title: Smart Education Lab: Polar Science Scholar Certification Launched
item.description: Interactive curriculum calibrating Antarctic, Arctic, and Himalayan polar science modules with cryptographically verifiable scholar certificates for students.
